translations.web: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.
translations.bsb: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle, it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil.
translations.kjv: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
translations.asv: And if thy oblation be a meal-offering of the baking-pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
